title: Trailer Craft
description: It is a simplistic and vibrant pack that is fun to use and makes your own Minecraft worlds look colourful!
body:
# ✨ TrailerCraft – Minecraft, Just Like the Trailers!
Ever wished Minecraft actually looked like its trailers? This modpack brings that cinematic beauty to life!
TrailerCraft enhances visuals, lighting, animations, and ambience — recreating that vibrant, polished, and atmospheric look you see in official Minecraft trailers, while keeping the classic vanilla feel intact.

## 🌅 Features:

Realistic yet soft lighting inspired by Mojang’s trailers

Enhanced water, shadows, and reflections

Smoother player and mob animations

Improved textures that stay true to vanilla style

Subtle particle and sound improvements for immersion

🎬 Step into Minecraft as it was _meant_ to look — straight out of the trailer.
